issuing_body: Minnesota Legislature / Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: 2026 Minnesota Laws, Chapter 116 — Minnesota State identity-verification appropriation
supports: 2026 Minn. Laws ch. 116 appropriates $3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities for acquisition, implementation, support, and maintenance of automated identity-verification systems to combat enrollment fraud.
The appropriation is one-time and remains available until June 30, 2029.

money.notes: Fraud-prevention system appropriation; not fraud loss, recovered amount, or identified-for-recovery.

does_not_support: The $3 million appropriation is not a measurement of enrollment-fraud losses.
The statute does not establish that every application flagged by an identity-verification system is fraudulent.
